title: Tokyo Ghoul

alternative_titles.ja: 東京喰種-トーキョーグール-

synopsis:
A sinister threat is invading Tokyo: flesh-eating "ghouls" who appear identical to humans and blend into their population. Reserved college student Ken Kaneki buries his nose in books and avoids the news of the growing crisis. However, the appearance of an attractive woman named Rize Kamishiro shatters his solitude when she forwardly asks him on a date.

While walking Rize home, Kaneki discovers she isn't as kind as she first appeared, and she has led him on with sinister intent. After a tragic struggle, he later awakens in a hospital to learn his life was saved by transplanting the now deceased Rize's organs into his own body.

Kaneki's body begins to change in horrifying ways, and he transforms into a human-ghoul hybrid. As he embarks on his new dreadful journey, Kaneki clings to his humanity in the evolving bloody conflict between society's new monsters and the government agents who hunt them.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
synopsis_es:
Una amenaza siniestra está invadiendo Tokio: "demonios" carnívoros que parecen idénticos a los humanos y se mezclan con su población. El reservado estudiante universitario Ken Kaneki esconde la nariz en los libros y evita las noticias sobre la creciente crisis. Sin embargo, la aparición de una mujer atractiva llamada Rize Kamishiro rompe su soledad cuando ella le pide una cita.

Mientras acompaña a Rize a casa, Kaneki descubre que ella no es tan amable como parecía al principio y lo ha engañado con intenciones siniestras. Después de una lucha trágica, más tarde se despierta en un hospital y descubre que le salvaron la vida trasplantando los órganos del ahora fallecido Rize a su propio cuerpo.

El cuerpo de Kaneki comienza a cambiar de maneras horribles y se transforma en un híbrido humano-ghoul. Mientras se embarca en su nuevo y terrible viaje, Kaneki se aferra a su humanidad en el sangriento conflicto en evolución entre los nuevos monstruos de la sociedad y los agentes del gobierno que los cazan.

[Escrito por MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: Tragedy
episodes_data.description: Amid news reports of "Ghoul" attacks nearby, Ken Kaneki points out Rize, a girl he is interested in, to his friend Hide at a local coffee shop. When Kaneki discovers the two share a favorite author, he asks her out. However, their date ends in tragedy!

episodes_data.title: Incubation
episodes_data.description: Kaneki desperately fights the urge to eat human flesh, the only thing that can satisfy his hunger as a ghoul. He meets up with Hide again, joining him on an errand, and is glad for the companionship. But will his declining condition place Hide at risk?

episodes_data.title: Dove
episodes_data.description: Yoshimura teaches Kaneki more about how to blend in with mankind, and takes in a mother and daughter needing protection. Two ghoul investigators, Mado and Amon, are assigned to the 20th Ward. In response, Touka takes Kaneki out to have a mask made for him.

episodes_data.title: Supper
episodes_data.description: Kaneki starts receiving self-defense lessons from Yomo. He meets Itori, who runs her own bar, and is friends with Uta and Yomo. Kaneki is befriended by Tsukiyama, a ghoul who knew Rize, who also enjoys reading, and possesses other, more epicurean tastes.

episodes_data.title: Scars
episodes_data.description: When Touka falls ill, Kaneki pays her a visit that has unexpected consequences. Meanwhile, as Nishiki is still recovering from his run-in with Kaneki, he is nearly preyed upon by other ghouls. Tsukiyama remains consumed with the idea of having Kaneki.

episodes_data.title: Cloudburst
episodes_data.description: The fight against Tsukiyama is resolved, but Touka wants to kill Kimi, now that it`s clear she knows that Nishiki and Kaneki are ghouls. Meanwhile, Hinami is eager to see her father again after being apart for so long, and acts out when she is unable.

episodes_data.title: Captivity
episodes_data.description: After Kaneki and Hinami witness Ryoko`s fate, the personnel at Anteiku are grieved, and Touka decides to take matters with the investigators into her own hands. Kaneki is fed up with not being able to do anything, and makes up his mind to become involved.

episodes_data.title: Circular
episodes_data.description: Touka sets out to lure the ghoul investigators, but before she can strike, she finds that Hinami has run away. When Touka and Kaneki go out looking for her, they find themselves face to face with Amon and Mado, who has a few surpises of his own for them.

episodes_data.title: Birdcage
episodes_data.description: After several weeks go by, everyone tries to return to their normal lives. Hinami moves in with Touka, and despite her aversion to birds, they nurse an injured cockatiel they name Hetare back to health. Kaneki visits Itori to try to learn more about Rize.

episodes_data.title: Aogiri
episodes_data.description: The 11th Ward offices of CCG are attacked by ghouls, wiping everyone out. Banjo and company stop in at Anteiku, looking for Rize to warn her to flee from Aogiri Tree, a new group of ghouls bent on taking over-- until Kaneki accidentally knocks him out!

episodes_data.title: High Spirits
episodes_data.description: Kaneki is held captive by Yamori, who practices his torturous craft on him. The police and CCG move in to deal with Aogiri Tree, who have made an 11th Ward shopping mall their headquarters. In all the commotion, the Anteiku team tries to rescue Kaneki.

episodes_data.title: Ghoul
episodes_data.description: As Yamori continues to brutally torture Kaneki, Rize once again appears to him, and the two of them explore Kaneki`s childhood and relationship with his mother. Kaneki is forced to make a choice that has a profound impact on him.

specials_data.title: Preview Collection
specials_data.description: Collection of the previews at the end of each episode. Released with FUNimation`s BluRay and DVD release.
